entities.summary: Three Kingdom, a political institution in China during Three Kingdoms to Sui Reunification (220–420). Grew from Battle of Red Cliffs — decisive battle shaping the Three Kingdoms. Led to the emergence of Sack of Luoyang and Chang'an by the Xiongnu — 'Disorder of the Five Barbarians' and Northern and Southern Dynasties.
